manifest.description: Extract a contiguous subsequence of a |> pipe chain into a named private function via elixir_pipe_chain_extract. Replaces the subsequence with a single piped call.
when_to_use: a pipe chain has a cohesive transformation segment that the operator wants named and reusable
a chain has grown long enough to obscure its intent and an extracted defp clarifies the data flow
anti_patterns: do not extract offset 0 (the chain head; refused with range_breaks_chain)
do not use to inline a piped function back into its caller's chain — that's the v2 direction=inline mode

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-pipe-chain-extract.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_pipe_chain_extract", source="{{source}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"anchor_line": {{anchor_line}}, "anchor_column": {{anchor_column}}, "extract_range_start_offset": {{extract_range_start_offset}}, "extract_range_end_offset": {{extract_range_end_offset}}, "visibility": "{{visibility}}"}).
2. Refuse on no_pipe_chain / range_breaks_chain / range_out_of_bounds / range_inverted.
3. Apply with mix compile + format check.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<extracted step count>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{anchor_line}} {{anchor_column}} {{extract_range_start_offset}} {{extract_range_end_offset}} {{visibility}} {{apply}}
